siteBill.title: Site Bill
siteBill.billTypeHint: Monthly bills and one-time fees must be filtered separately; they cannot be shown in the same list.
siteBill.rule1: Game line items in monthly bill "Detail" are aggregated in real time from BetTransactionDaily (natural month YYYY-MM within bill_month); "Betlog Rebuild" writes the same standard to the billing table and refreshes payable amounts. Currency BRL; commission from site_game_vendor_commissions, default 6% if not matched (HG_ prefix stripped for fallback). Optional SITE_BILL_BETLOG_TIMEZONE limits daily report timezone.
siteBill.rule2: Bill settlement requires sufficient site balance; before payment confirm "Site Balance" and "Actual Pay Total (incl. late fee)".
siteBill.rule3: Pending Issue: current or previous month bills remain pending until the 6th 00:00:00 of next month; after the 6th they auto-move to Pending Verify. After site confirms, status becomes Pending Payment; system may auto-change after 15 days.
siteBill.rule4: Pending Payment: pay when balance is sufficient; recharge first if insufficient. Auto-overdue after 30 days. Disputes adjusted manually by finance; may re-issue or change to Pending Payment after communication.
siteBill.rule5: Late Fee (V6.5): bill overdue after end of next month; +0.05%/day on total, no cap. Overdue bills do not receive discounts.
siteBill.globalCommissionHint: Rows come from enabled game platforms; "Platform Name + Game Type" matches bill detail; only commission rate is editable. Save replaces site_game_vendor_commissions entirely. Unconfigured platforms default to 6%; vendor-only rules with empty type serve as fallback.
siteBill.noEnabledPlatforms: No enabled game platforms. Please enable platforms in Game Platform Management first.
siteBill.insufficientBalance: Main site balance insufficient. Please recharge first.
siteBill.recalcSuccess: Bill commission recalculated from global config
siteBill.rebuildContent: Deletes current game line items and rebuilds from BetTransactionDaily for the bill month; CDN/line fees retained; payable total (incl. game) recalculated. Paid/bad-debt bills cannot be modified.
siteBill.noPlatformsWarning: No enabled game platforms. Please enable platforms in Game Platform Management first.
